SELECTED_INDEX: 8
CONFIDENCE: 0.32
EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows the characteristic SO₂ pattern: a very strong asymmetric stretch doublet at 1369–1386 cm⁻¹, the symmetric stretch near 1100 cm⁻¹ and the SO₂ bending band at 640 cm⁻¹. Only candidate 8 (NCc1ccc(S(N)(=O)=O)cc1) contains an SO₂ (sulfonamide) group. Peaks at 1588/1622 cm⁻¹ fit N-H bending of the sulfonamide and benzyl-amine, while the strong aromatic C–H stretch at 3057 cm⁻¹ and ring modes at 750, 1033 and 1490 cm⁻¹ match a para-disubstituted benzene. No strong C=O band (~1700 cm⁻¹) is present, disfavoring candidates bearing carbonyl groups. Thus candidate 8 best matches the observed Raman peaks.
